nodes.description: Private string state variable holding the token name 'BB Erzurumspor Token', set at declaration and consumed by the ERC20 base constructor.
Private string state variable holding the token symbol 'ERZ', passed to the ERC20 base constructor.
Private uint8 state variable holding the token decimals value (2), returned by the overridden decimals() function.
Private uint state variable holding the initial supply (25000000000) minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Public constant bytes32 role identifier keccak256('BURNER_ROLE') used to gate the burn function.
Constructor of ERZToken: initializes ERC20 metadata, grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE to msg.sender, and mints the initial supply.
Public burn function: requires the caller to hold BURNER_ROLE, then burns tokens from arbitrary 'from' address and emits Burned.
Public view override returning the custom __decimals value instead of the ERC20 default 18.
msg.sender referenced in the ERZToken constructor as recipient of the admin/burner roles and the initial mint.
_msgSender() referenced in burn(), used as the account checked against BURNER_ROLE (resolves to msg.sender via Context).
_setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender) — grants the admin role without any access check; privileged state write controlled by the deployer address.
_setupRole(BURNER_ROLE, msg.sender) — grants the burner role without any access check to the deployer.
_mint(msg.sender, __INITIAL_SUPPLY) — increases _totalSupply and _balances, an arithmetic supply mutation.
hasRole(BURNER_ROLE, _msgSender()) access-control check that gates the burn path.
_burn(from, amount) — decreases the balance of an arbitrary 'from' address and the total supply; reachable only after the BURNER_ROLE check.
Address parameter 'from' of burn(), the account whose tokens are destroyed; can be any address chosen by the burner.
uint256 parameter 'amount' of burn(), the quantity of tokens to destroy.

edges.reason: __name is read and passed to the ERC20 base constructor for token initialization.
__symbol is read and passed to the ERC20 base constructor for token initialization.
decimals() returns the __decimals state variable, overriding the ERC20 default.
__INITIAL_SUPPLY is the amount added to total supply and balances in _mint.
BURNER_ROLE constant is granted via _setupRole to the deployer.
BURNER_ROLE constant is the role compared in the hasRole access check.
Constructor executes _mint to create the initial token supply.
msg.sender is the account that receives DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, making the initial admin externally controlled.
msg.sender is the account that receives BURNER_ROLE.
msg.sender is the recipient of the initial mint.
_msgSender() is the untrusted account validated against BURNER_ROLE before burning.
Passing the hasRole(BURNER_ROLE) check is the only condition allowing _burn to be reached.
burn() executes the hasRole(BURNER_ROLE, _msgSender()) requirement before proceeding.
burn() calls _burn(from, amount) after the role check.
The 'from' parameter is the target account of the _burn state mutation.
The 'amount' parameter is the value deducted in the _burn state mutation.
